payload: {"code":"{\"v\":2,\"language\":\"JS\",\"entry\":\"index.js\",\"imports\":{},\"files\":{\"index.js\":\"export const createScene = function () {\\n    // This creates a basic Babylon Scene object (non-mesh)\\n    var scene = new BABYLON.Scene(engine);\\n\\n    // This creates and positions a free camera (non-mesh)\\n    var camera = new BABYLON.FreeCamera(\\\"camera1\\\", new BABYLON.Vector3(0, 5, -10), scene);\\n\\n    // This targets the camera to scene origin\\n    camera.setTarget(BABYLON.Vector3.Zero());\\n\\n    // This attaches the camera to the canvas\\n    camera.attachControl(canvas, true);\\n\\n    // This creates a light, aiming 0,1,0 - to the sky (non-mesh)\\n    var light = new BABYLON.HemisphericLight(\\\"light\\\", new BABYLON.Vector3(0, 1, 0), scene);\\n\\n    // Default intensity is 1. Let's dim the light a small amount\\n    light.intensity = 0.7;\\n\\n    // Our built-in 'cube' shape.\\n    var cube = BABYLON.MeshBuilder.CreateBox(\\\"cube\\\", {diameter: 2, segments: 32}, scene);\\n\\n    // Move the cube upward 1/2 its height\\n    cube.position.y = 1;\\n\\n    // Create a material for the cube\\n    var material = new BABYLON.StandardMaterial(\\\"cubeMaterial\\\", scene);\\n    cube.material = material;\\n\\n    // Create a time variable for the sinusoid\\n    var time = 0;\\n\\n    //Create a function to run repeatedly for each frame\\n    scene.onBeforeRenderObservable.add(function () {\\n    \\n    //Create a small time interval to advance\\n    time += 0.02;\\n\\n    // Task 1 - Change the color sinusoidally by 120 degrees for smoothness\\n    var red = (Math.sin(time) + 1) / 2;\\n    var green = (Math.sin(time + 2 * Math.PI / 3) + 1) / 2;\\n    var blue = (Math.sin(time + 4 * Math.PI / 3) + 1) / 2;\\n    material.diffuseColor = new BABYLON.Color3(red, green, blue);\\n\\n    // Task 2 - Change the position sinusoidally\\n    cube.position.y = 2 + Math.sin(time);\\n\\n    // Task 3 - Change the scale sinusoidally without going through the floor\\n    cube.scaling = new BABYLON.Vector3(\\n    1 + 0.5 * Math.sin(time),\\n    1 + 0.5 * Math.sin(time),\\n    1 + 0.5 * Math.sin(time)\\n    );\\n\\n    });\\n\\n\\n    // Our built-in 'ground' shape.\\n    var ground = BABYLON.MeshBuilder.CreateGround(\\\"ground\\\", {width: 6, height: 6}, scene);\\n\\n    return scene;\\n};\"}}","engine":"WebGL2","version":2}
